# TG Validator Telegram Bulk Profile Check
> Official examples for the TG Validator bulk product `tg_profile_batch`.

## Canonical resources
- [Product page](https://tgvalidator.com/products/tg_profile_batch): Username, user ID, first and last name, gender, age band, ethnicity and avatar across a whole list, plus last-seen time, active days and the member flag.
- [API documentation](https://tgvalidator.com/api-docs): Canonical request, response, limit, and error contract.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/tgvalidator/telegram-bulk-profile-api): Official multi-language examples and OpenAPI contract.
- [Registration](https://tgvalidator.com/register): Account registration and API-key access.
- [Pricing](https://tgvalidator.com/pricing): Current product pricing.

## Product facts
- Brand: TG Validator.
- Product code: tg_profile_batch.
- Mode: asynchronous bulk task.
- API base URL: https://tgvalidator.com.
- Authentication: X-API-Key request header.
- Submit: POST /api/v1/bulk-tasks with product=tg_profile_batch, country and a file field.
- Poll: GET /api/v1/bulk-tasks/{id}; status is processing, success or failed.
- Poll interval: no more than once every 30 seconds.
- Task size: 1000 to 100000 entries, .txt or .csv, one phone number per line.
- Input kind: phone.
- Country: required, one country per task.
- Result columns: Phone, activated, uid, username, first_name, last_name, Last Online Time, Active Days, Is Member, Avatar, Gender, Age, Ethnicity.
- Billing: the file is reserved on submit; only checked entries are charged and the rest is returned. Failed tasks are refunded.
- Examples: Python, Node.js, Go, Java, C#, PHP, Shell.
